_doc: SINGLE SOURCE OF TRUTH for character appearance + the cast-differentiation block injected into multi-character prompts. build_episode.py reads this instead of hard-coding the block, so a face/silhouette is fixed in ONE place. `appearance_lock` is the verbatim phrasing that MUST appear so the look does not drift across episodes; `ref_images` are optional reference renders for an img2img / IP-Adapter consistency pass.
